shortDescription: Barret Zoph was fired from Thinking Machines Lab amid a dispute with Chief Executive Mira Murati. "Thinking Machines Lab Co-Founder Barret Zoph Joins Google," at 9:46 p.m. ET on Aug. 26, incorrectly said he defected to OpenAI.
